title: ‘Umamusume: Cinderella Gray’ Vol. 23 Bows at No. 1 on Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 as ‘Project Hail Mary’ Returns to Top 20
summary: Yama Wayama’s Famiresu Iko. Part 2 holds at No. 2.
contentText:
Taiyo Kuzumi, Masafumi Sugiura & Pita, Junnosuke Ito’s Umamusume: Cinderella Gray Vol. 23 debuts at No. 1 on the Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 list released Mar. 26.

Umamusume: Cinderella Gray is a spinoff manga from the Umamusume: Pretty Derby franchise, centered on fan-favorite character Oguri Cap. The series was adapted into an anime series last year, and this 23rd volume serves as the last in the manga version. The title topped the e-book metric this week while also placing at No. 6 in brick-and-mortar sales and No. 16 in e-commerce (EC).

Yama Wayama’s Famiresu Iko . Part 2 holds at No. 2 with three metrics inside the top 20: No. 2 in brick-and-mortar sales, No. 7 in e-books, and No. 13 in e-commerce. After topping the chart twice in a row, Eiichiro Oda’s ONE PIECE Vol. 114 stays within the the top 3, extending its brick-and-mortar streak at No. 1 to three consecutive weeks. The digital edition is scheduled for release Apr. 3. 

In other chart news, the translated version of Andy Weir’s Project Hail Mary — the Hollywood film adaptation starring Ryan Gosling opened in Japanese cinemas Mar. 20 — jumps back into the top 20 at No. 16. The title lands at No. 3 on the social media metric and scores points across all five tracked metrics: brick-and-mortar, EC, e-books, and subscriptions.

The Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 is a comprehensive chart combining physical sales, e-books, library loans, subscription data and social media activity. Below is the top 10 titles on this week’s list, tracking the period from Mar. 16 to Mar. 22.

(Numbers in parentheses indicate the title’s metric placements for brick-and-mortar, EC, e-books, subscriptions, and social media, top 20 only. English title given if translations or adaptations exist.)
